operator_io_quirks: All 7 tables have 0 rows: original_values empty, original_sizes all 0; literal pool is the ONLY source of realistic values.
Mixed-case quoted identifiers everywhere ("Songs","SongId","BandmateId"); must double-quote and preserve case.
Column name 'Year' (INTEGER) is a whole-word reserved-ish token: extract_typed_values must placeholder-rare it before sqlparse.
Column 'Type' appears in Albums and Vocals; 'Title' in Songs and Albums; 'SongId' in 5 tables -> column-name anchors are ambiguous, FK-root mapping matters.
Composite PKs: Instruments(SongId,BandmateId,Instrument), Performance(SongId,Bandmate), Tracklists(AlbumId,Position), Vocals(SongId,Bandmate) -> composite-PK members get max_l0=30.
Instruments PK includes a TEXT column (Instrument) -> PK-duplicate dropping on a string column; String fuzzer contamination can create collisions.
FK child column names differ from parent: BandmateId/Bandmate -> Band.Id, AlbumId -> Albums.AId; FK fill must use parent column values, not name match.
No self-FKs, no dangling FKs, no NOT NULL, no CHECK, no UNIQUE, no indexes/views/triggers: schema is clean, all constraints are PK/FK only.
All declared types are plain INTEGER/TEXT -> dispatch to Number and String only; no Date/Time/Bool/Bit/fallback paths exercised here.
notnull=0 on PK columns (sqlite quirk: INTEGER PRIMARY KEY is implicitly NOT NULL but pragma reports 0) -> TS will not enforce NOT NULL, fine.
Table order: Songs, Albums, Band are level 0; Instruments/Performance/Tracklists/Vocals level 1 (children of Songs/Band/Albums).
Empty originals mean read_schema's rowid sampling is trivial; no huge-table concern for this DB.
operator_ts_expectations: Number fuzzer on all INTEGER columns: scale=0, range [-1,1] (10^0), int perturbation +-1/+-2 -> SongId/AId/Id/Year/Position collapse to tiny set {-2..2}.
String fuzzer on TEXT columns: charset a-zA-Z 0-9() length 0..20, 50% contaminate -> Titles/Labels/Instruments are gibberish, never real album/band names.
No literal pool from originals (0 rows) -> elements = distinct pool values only; if pool empty, p=1 -> pure random for every column.
PK uniqueness: Number draws from {-2..2} for SongId -> sample_fresh_primary_keys drops most rows; Songs/Albums/Band end up with <=5 rows regardless of chosen size.
Composite PKs with a Number member (SongId,Bandmate) also collapse to <=25 distinct tuples -> Performance/Vocals tiny.
FK fill draws from parent's FINAL filtered values with replacement -> heavy duplicate (SongId,Bandmate) pairs, then PK dedup shrinks further.
Year column gets values in {-2..2} -> implausible years; queries filtering Year>1990 return empty -> FN risk (gold non-empty on real DB, empty here).
String contamination on Instrument/Type/Title creates near-duplicates -> GROUP BY / DISTINCT queries may over- or under-count vs real DB.
Empty originals + tiny generated tables -> many gold queries return 0 rows on instances; result_eq both-empty=True masks differences (FP risk).
No Date/Time columns -> Date/Time fuzzers never run; no template/format quirks to survive here.
Number list_max quirk (overwrite with full-range max) is moot: no elements from originals, only pool values.
Neighbor queries on empty schema clone: all execute (no data), so executability filter keeps almost everything -> large neighbor sets.
